items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: King Phillips, William King Phillips, is the one, uh, that, uh, uh, to take me to hear this band.

ctx.x: Was it different than the other Chicago bands?

Oh, my goodness. King Phillips, William King Phillips, is the one, uh, that, uh, uh, to take me to hear this band. They gave, just, they just gave a kind of a free concert for all Chicago musicians to come and listen to the Dixieland style of music, which we had never heard. And, of course, you know the history tells us that, uh, everybody went wild. All the musicians started drumming.
Was it much different style than, uh, the Memphis music that you'd heard down there and been playing?
